Title: Balboa Park
description: Sprawling outdoor destination is home to the city's renowned zoo, museums, gardens & more.

Title: San Diego Zoo
description: Zoo featuring giraffes, koalas, apes & more, plus tours & a conservation society.

Title: USS Midway Aricraft Carrier Museum
description: Life-at-sea exhibits, restored planes & flight simulators aboard this legendary aircraft carrier.

Title: Petco Park
description: Major league baseball stadium home of the San Diego Padres.

Title: Cabrillo National Monument
description: This historic lighthouse & national monument offers a storied history & views all the way to Mexico.

Title: SeaWorld
description: Marine life shows, thrill rides, aquariums & up-close encounters with dolphins, penguins & more.

Title: Seaport Village
description: Waterside complex with shops, eateries, entertainment & relaxed grounds featuring fountains & ponds.

Title: Torrey Pines Nature Preserve
description: Acres of oceanside trails for exploring or exercising while spotting occasional dolphins or bobcats.

Title: Old Town San Diego
description: Old Town San Diego is considered the “birthplace” of California. San Diego is the site of the first permanent Spanish settlement in California.

Title: Coronado
description: Bay island with a historic town, home to an iconic Victorian hotel, plus some of San Diego's best beaches.

Title: La Jolla Shores Park
description: 2-block space steps away from the sand & waves offers grassy area & playgrounds.

Title: San Diego Air and Space Museum
description: Popular museum with historical aircraft/spacecraft & interactive exhibits, plus a gift shop & grill.

Title: Maritime Museum of San Diego
description: Waterfront venue showcasing many types of restored vintage ships & historical exhibits.

Title: Lifeguard La Jolla Cove
description: Cozy stretch of sand tucked between sandstone cliffs for swimmers, snorkelers & scuba divers.

Title: Mission Beach Boardwalk
description: Longtime beachfront boardwalk featuring shops, an old-school amusement park & ocean activities.

Title: Belmont Park
description: Vintage games, gift shops, rides & an iconic wooden roller coaster right next to the beach.

Title: Little Italy
description: Little Italy is a chic, pedestrian-friendly neighborhood, packed with trendy cocktail bars, brewpubs and restaurants with bustling patios. Upscale clothing boutiques, indie music venues and quaint piazzas dot the area, while the weekly Little Italy Mercato Farmers’ Market draws crowds to its mix of produce, gourmet food and craft stalls. The green lawns of Waterfront Park have fountains, and offer views of the bay.

Title: Annie's Canyon Trail
description: Rugged wilderness hiking paths in an ecological reserve with sweeping ocean & lagoon views.

Title: Sunset Cliffs Natural Park
description: Natural cliffs overlooking the Pacific Ocean offer views of the coast & the occasional cliff diver.

Title: Mission Trails Regional Park
description: 8,000-acre recreational park featuring 60 miles of trails, along with a lake for boating & camping.

Title: La Jolla Trail
description: Sweeping ocean views are offered from this rugged hiking trail with steep, narrow sections.

Title: San Diego Convention Center
description: The San Diego Convention Center is a stunning waterfront venue known for its iconic architecture and spacious halls. Located downtown, it hosts major events like Comic-Con and trade shows. With panoramic bay views, excellent facilities, and nearby dining and hotels, it’s a premier destination for business and entertainment gatherings alike. It has MTS connectivity too and there's a station opposite to the center.
